cohort: 120 pregnant women (>28 weeks gestation), comprising 60 with placenta previa (cases) and 60 controls without placenta previa.
finding: Elevated maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein (MSAFP) levels were significantly higher in women with placenta previa (75% vs 3% in controls), with higher levels correlating with more severe grades of the condition.
mod_finding: The placenta previa group, which also had elevated MSAFP, experienced higher rates of emergency caesarean sections.
